en.question: A delete_records tool is defined with a filter parameter. During testing the agent once called it with an empty filter, which would have deleted everything. What is the correct set of changes?

options.text: Require the filter, reject broad filters, cap affected rows, gate on approval.
Add a prominent warning to the tool description and monitor future calls.
options.note: A description influences behaviour but cannot prevent the call.

options.text: Rename the tool to something less inviting for the model to reach for.
options.note: Naming does not constrain what the handler will execute.

options.text: Set temperature to 0 on any request where this tool is made available.
options.note: Sampling temperature is not a safety control.

en.explanation: Layered deterministic defences for a destructive capability: the schema makes the filter mandatory, the handler bounds the blast radius, and a human gate stands in front of the irreversible action.
